A comma separated string with child ages. No space after comma. Example: childAges=0,5,14. Age ranges are, infant: 0-1, child: 2-12, youth: 13-17, adults: 18+.
Code of the departure airport. Any valid IATA airport code.
Date of departure. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: departuredate=2035-01-31.
Code of the destination airport. Any valid IATA airport code.
Date of return. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: returnDate=2035-01-31.
Number of nights between departure date and return date.
If true then only one way flights are returned, if false then one way flights are not returned. If omitted then all flights are returned.
The number of items to return. Default: 100, maximum: 1000.
Used for pagination. For performance reasons, do not use without adding other query parameters.
If true returns flights from TUIfly Nordic and TUI Airways. If false or omitted returns all airlines.

query.description:
(Required) Number of Adults in the request.

Accepted Values - 1 to 6

Ages of Children in the request separated by comma. If no children are sent in the request, this parameter should not be sent (or sent as ?childAges=).

For 2 children with age 5 and 7, the value should be 5,7.
Age ranges are, infant: 0-1, child: 2-12, youth: 13-17.

(Required) The G- code value for each destination that is mapped through the locations endpoint.
Multiple destinations can be sent in the request separated by comma.

Example: G-000000234,G-000000256,G-000000293,G-000000293
(Required) Date of arrival from. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: arrivaldatefrom=2035-01-31

(Required) Date of arrival to.
Date must be compatible with ISO 8601.

Example: arrivaldateto=2035-01-31
(Required) A list of one or more stay durations. Example: 3,5,7,14

A list of airportcodes separated by comma that are requested by user as Departure locations.

Example: ARN,GOT,CPH
The number of items to return. Maximum: 100.

variable.description:
(Required) Your agent code. Use the same for every request made.

Example - tui

(Required) The source market code.

Accepted values: dk, fi, no, se.

description.content:
The Meta Partner Packages & Flights provides a suite of RESTful endpoints that enable meta partners to search 
for and retrieve up-to-date information on flights and travel packages.
It allows clients to integrate real-time availability and pricing into their applications.
